renderings.value: Cultures have a coherent view of the world.

The interdependence of thought and speech makes it clear that languages are not so much a means of expressing truth that has already been established, but a means of discovering truth that was previously unknown. Their diversity is a diversity not of sounds and signs but of ways of looking at the world.
I want to see the world through your eyes.
We each have our own view of the world.
Each person has their own way of looking at the world.
Each person has their own view of the world.
Each person has his or her own view of the world.
Each person has his or her own way of looking at the world.
